name: egressbook

headline.en: What left your machine — named, mapped, signed.
headline.zh: 离开你机器的，是什么——逐项点名、按目的地映射、已签名。

sub.en: egressbook turns your coding agents' local session logs into a signed egress disclosure ledger. Retrospective, evidence-linked, zero network calls.
sub.zh: egressbook 把编码 Agent 的本地会话日志变成一份签名的出站披露账本。回溯过去、证据可溯源、零网络请求。

body.en: Tripwires catch the next unauthorized connection; gateways see only traffic routed through them. egressbook reconstructs months of past sessions from the logs already on disk.
body.zh: 绊线只能抓下一次未授权连接，网关只看得见流经它的流量。egressbook 从磁盘上已有的日志重建过去几个月的会话。

body.en: Every item carries an evidence locator back to the exact log line, the whole artifact is ed25519-signed, and any edit after signing fails verification. It is an audit asset you can diff across sessions.
body.zh: 每个条目都带回到精确日志行的证据定位符；整份工件经 ed25519 签名，签名后任何改动都会校验失败。这是一份可跨会话 diff 的审计资产。

body.en: ZCode logs carry full outbound request bodies; Codex records provider, instructions and tool outputs; Claude Code logs omit the system prompt and per-session provider — egressbook prints those as explicit gaps instead of guessing.
body.zh: ZCode 日志记录完整出站请求体；Codex 记录厂商、指令与工具输出；Claude Code 日志不含系统提示词与每会话厂商——egressbook 把这些打印成显式缺口，而不是猜测。

body.en: A disclosure tool that phones home would be a joke. The binary performs zero network calls — verify it with a firewall.
body.zh: 会外联的披露工具是个笑话。这个二进制零网络请求——你可以用防火墙验证。

quickstart.title: Run it on your machine
quickstart.body: No config, no account, no API key. Reads only local logs.

limitations: The ledger reconstructs everything logged, not everything sent — channels absent from local logs cannot be attested and are labeled as gaps.
v0.2 ships parsers for ZCode, Codex, and Claude Code session logs; Cursor support is on the roadmap.
Classification of file_content / code_snippet uses conservative path-and-fence heuristics; borderline blocks may be labeled user_message.

caption.en: Your machine on the left; every destination it talked to, on the right.
caption.zh: 左边是你的机器；右边是它交谈过的每一个目的地。

title.zh: 两次披露，一个无人能答的问题

body.en: In September 2026 two independent researchers documented a widely-used coding agent silently uploading Git history to its vendor's cloud — 462 combined Hacker News points, discovery by outsiders, forensics by hand. Every affected user had the same question and no tool to answer it: what of mine already left this machine, and to whom?
body.zh: 2026 年 9 月，两位独立研究者证实一个广泛使用的编码 Agent 在静默上传 Git 历史到厂商云端——Hacker News 合计 462 分，发现来自外部，取证靠手工。每个受影响的用户都有同一个问题，却没有工具能回答：已经离开我这台机器的是什么、去了谁那里？

title.zh: 解析 → 分类 → 签名

body.en: Three parsers read the session-log formats of ZCode (including its full outbound request bodies), Codex, and Claude Code. Every payload block is classified — system prompt, user message, file content, code snippet, tool result, git artifact — and mapped to the provider it was sent to. The result is canonicalized and signed with a persistent ed25519 key.
body.zh: 三个解析器读取 ZCode（含完整出站请求体）、Codex 与 Claude Code 的会话日志格式。每个载荷块被分类——系统提示词、用户消息、文件内容、代码片段、工具结果、git 工件——并映射到它被发送到的厂商。结果经规范化后用持久 ed25519 密钥签名。

alt.zh: 解析、分类、签名三段流水线

body.en: The ledger aggregates outbound bytes per destination and per payload kind, so the first thing you see is the shape of your exposure: which vendors hold how much of your context. Every row is drillable to the evidence line.
body.zh: 账本按目的地与载荷类型聚合出站字节，你第一眼看到的就是暴露的形状：哪些厂商持有你多少上下文。每一行都能下钻到证据行。

alt.zh: 按厂商聚合的出站字节映射

title.zh: 每次 Agent 升级后 diff

body.en: The recurring ritual: after your agent updates, run egressbook diff and see whether anything new started leaving — new destinations, new payload kinds, per-destination deltas. A signed record of what changed, not a feeling.
body.zh: 可复利的习惯：Agent 升级后跑一次 diff，看是否有新东西开始外流——新目的地、新载荷类型、按目的地的增量。一份关于变化的签名记录，而不是一种感觉。

alt.zh: 两次账本之间的差异对比

body.en: The report labels what each harness's logs can and cannot prove, per harness, before you read a single number.
body.zh: 报告在你读任何数字之前，先按 harness 标注其日志能证明与不能证明的边界。

details.code:
egressbook scan
claude-code  sessions: found=1 parsed=1
      gap: system prompt is harness-side and not written to session logs

title.zh: 校验一份分享来的账本

body.en: A reviewer can check the signature of a ledger you hand them; any edit after signing fails.
body.zh: 审查者可以校验你交给他们的账本签名；签名后任何改动都会失败。
